detail: normalized path climbs above the web root

proposed.label: CWE-22
proposed.rationale: The earlier query-parameter traversal was ignored, returning a directory listing instead. This request percent-encodes dot-dot path segments within the URL path itself to attempt a classic encoding-bypass traversal against the /ftp static file handler, targeting /etc/passwd outside the web root.

detail: normalized path climbs above the web root

proposed.label: CWE-22
proposed.rationale: The previous traversal used four dot-dot segments and was rejected as climbing above root. This attempt uses only two nested segments so the normalized path remains under the application root, while still escaping the /ftp directory. If the static file handler decodes percent-encoded dot-dots, it should disclose package.json.
